Kit summary

Ruthless ExecutionActive
Deals 450% ATK Internal Injury DMG to one enemy and inflicts Chill II for 2 turns. Under Arcane Seal Focus, the DMG type becomes HP Deduction DMG.
Peerless Sword DanceActive
Deals 2 stages of DMG to one enemy: 500% ATK HP Deduction DMG, then 500% ATK HP Deduction DMG that steals 20% of the target's Turn Meter. Under Sword Dance Focus (+50% Mastery and Internal Injury DMG dealt), the DMG type becomes Internal Injury DMG.
Demonhunter Blades Lv.1Casting it grants White Stealth for 2 turns.
Alder SealPassive
Starts battle with 2 layers of Arcane Seal. At end of her turn, if Arcane Seal and Sword Dance are both under 8 layers, gains 1 Sword Dance. Ally HP Deduction DMG converts 1 Sword Dance into Arcane Seal (3 times before she acts); ally Internal Injury DMG converts all Arcane Seal into Sword Dance. At turn start, if Arcane Seal > Sword Dance and >= 5, enters Arcane Seal Focus (HP Deduction DMG removes 1 buff and has 30% chance to Stun) and removes all Sword Dance; if Sword Dance > Arcane Seal and >= 5, enters Sword Dance Focus and removes all Arcane Seal. The Focus ends at end of turn.
Demonhunter Blades Lv.1Under Arcane Seal Focus, ATK +5% per Arcane Seal layer. Under Sword Dance Focus, Mastery +5% per Sword Dance layer.
Demonhunter Blades Lv.2Starts battle with 3 layers of Sword Dance. Entering Arcane Seal Focus gains 1 Mutation (+20% Skill DMG) and removes 1 Predator Instinct (+20% Internal Injury DMG); entering Sword Dance Focus gains 1 Predator Instinct and removes 1 Mutation (up to 3 layers). Gains Control Immunity at 5+ Arcane Seal layers and +20% SPD at 5+ Sword Dance layers.
Gale Cyclone SlashUltimate
Deals 600% ATK Internal Injury DMG to all enemies. Outside Focus, gains 1 Arcane Seal and 1 Sword Dance. Under Arcane Seal Focus, also deals 400% ATK HP Deduction DMG and inflicts Arcane Seal Rift (-20% Mastery RES; converts to Soul-Scorching Erosion on Burn DMG, up to 2 layers). Under Sword Dance Focus, also deals 400% ATK Internal Injury DMG and inflicts Armor-Rending Wound (-30% Tenacity; converts to Deep Wound on Crit DMG taken, up to 2 layers; Boss DEF becomes 1 at 2 layers).
Demonhunter Blades Lv.3When White first gains 5 layers of Arcane Seal or Sword Dance, she removes all control effects, enters the matching Focus and immediately casts Gale Cyclone Slash once. Each Focus entry reduces its CD by 1 turn. When it deals Internal Injury DMG to a Boss, Internal Injury DMG dealt +200% per Sword Dance layer.
Demonhunter Blades (Exclusive) levels are shown under each skill they change.

Traveler’s Diary
The Traveler's Diary
Main statATK Rate

At the beginning of the owner's turn, grants one of the Travelogue Pages randomly to all allies:

1. Increases all allies' ATK by 9% of the owner's initial ATK.

2. Increases all allies' Crit DMG by 27%.

3. Increases all allies' Skill DMG by 9%.

Only 1 layer of Travelogue Page can be owned at the same time and all allies share the same effect. The effects mentioned above will be removed once the owner dies.
